detail: Guardrails of the customs house: The seal never writes the hollis ledger — clearance is permission, entry is adoption. No invented figure wears a citation — band cut-offs, weigh-points and rate numbers are ours, labeled hypothesized. The original stays missing — no scene may open the niche; the chain of certified copies is the culture. The princess does not clear goods.
note: The guardrails define what the customs house may and may not do. The seal is not an entry; clearance is not adoption.
